policy: Catalog Hard Gates are not relaxed. Every one must pass for Candidate Catalog v1 to be promoted. They are deliberately about safety and reachability rather than about ranking quality: a catalog that keeps every valid candidate and lets the user reach all of them is useful even while the recommendation order is still being improved.
separation: Recommendation quality is measured separately in 00-recommendation-targets.json and is NOT a promotion condition for the catalog. Requiring a perfect recommender before shipping a non-destructive catalog would hold the safety net hostage to the ranking problem.

gates.description: Every CandidatePattern that meets the quality floor is reachable from the UI, whether or not it was recommended.
gates.failureScenario: A generated, valid progression exists in the analysis but the user has no way to see it.

gates.description: Every occurrence of a displayed pattern is reachable from its card.
gates.failureScenario: The second chorus exists in the pattern but cannot be opened, auditioned or saved.

gates.description: No pattern occupies more than one card in any lane.
gates.failureScenario: The reported Endless defect: the same Em11/A pattern takes several of the visible slots.

gates.description: No display slot is spent on a pattern already shown.
No two catalog entries share start, end, canonical event sequence, duration pattern, patternId, absolute chords and occurrence identity.
gates.note: Only exact identity is merged. Two occurrences of one pattern at different positions are NOT duplicates.

gates.description: Every must-show block the generator produced is present in the catalog.
gates.note: This is about presence in the catalog, not about rank. A block ranked hundredth still passes.

gates.description: Every occurrence in the catalog can be auditioned individually.
Every occurrence in the catalog can be saved individually.
Catalog work does not reach the detector.
The same input produces the same catalog and the same recommendation order.
Catalog construction stays inside the interactive budget.

criticalGuards.note: Known severe UX defects that must not recur. These are pass/fail alongside the Hard Gates even though general recommendation quality is not.

guards.rationale: A song with one progression must not be presented as ten candidates built from sub-windows of it.

guards.expectation: Recommendation section hidden; vamp / fragment / uncertain lanes still populated
Catalog 1 card, 4 occurrences, at most 1 recommendation slot
One Em11/A card with all its occurrences; no duplicate card; with three or more progressions available a two-bar vamp does not occupy the top three; the vamp stays in the catalog
0 recommendations admitted solely to reach the display cap
